title: Bash timeout message always says 'seconds', even for a 1-second timeout
observed: 'sleep 5' against a 1-second timeout reads '→ Command timed out after 1 seconds' (01-bash-timeout.txt).
expected: Singular 'second' when the timeout value is 1.
design_ref: internal/tools/bash.go:159 (fmt.Sprintf("Command timed out after %v seconds", timeout.Seconds()) always pluralizes)
